verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows only bot/CAPTCHA protection (vercel-docs-11) and generic identity-based security (vercel-docs-13), but no documentation of a web application firewall or automatic DDoS mitigation applied to every request by default. A community report even suggests undetected DDoS incidents can occur and rack up large bills (vercel-comm-12), further indicating this isn't a guaranteed default protection.
